8.3.21 CanNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMsg
[SWS_CanNm_91005] Definition of API function CanNm_ActivateTxPnShutdown
Msg
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02572,
SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00460,
SRS_BSW_-
00461, SRS_BSW_00484, SRS_BSW_00459
⌈
Service Name
CanNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMsg
Syntax
Std_ReturnType CanNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMsg (
NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle
)
Service ID [hex]
0xf4
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different nmChannelHandle. Non reentrant for the same nmChannelHandle.
Parameters (in)
nmChannelHandle
Identifier of the NM-Channel where the PNC shutdown process is
started.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK:Request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Request has not been accepted.
Description
NM indicate to activate the transmission of PN shutdown messages on the given NM-Channel.
This results in transmission of a NM-PDU with PNSR bit set to 1 (PN shutdown message).
Available via
CanNm.h
